entries.passageText: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.
entries.reflection: Jonah left in anger, then called from the darkness: there is no god but You, glory be to You, I have been a wrongdoer. Frustration can turn to prayer.
studyPrompts: What frustrates you?
Where have you acted in anger?
What prayer could you pray?

entries.passageText: No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things.
entries.reflection: No calamity strikes except by Allah's leave, and whoever believes, He guides their heart. Acceptance and guidance go together.
studyPrompts: What are you struggling to accept?
How could faith guide your heart?
Who supports you?

entries.passageText: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.
entries.reflection: Establish prayer; prayer restrains from indecency and wrong, and remembrance of Allah is greater. Good habits protect us.
studyPrompts: What habits protect you?
Which habit has slipped?
What habit could you strengthen?

entries.passageText: And say not of anything: Lo! I shall do that tomorrow, Except if Allah will. And remember thy Lord when thou forgettest, and say: It may be that my Lord guideth me unto a nearer way of truth than this.
entries.reflection: Do not say I will surely do that tomorrow without saying, if Allah wills. Holding plans loosely softens disappointment.
studyPrompts: What plan fell through?
How do you hold plans?
What might be a nearer way?

entries.passageText: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
entries.reflection: Abraham prayed: grant me a good reputation among later generations. Legacy is how we are remembered.
studyPrompts: How do you want to be remembered?
What are you doing now that will last?
Whose legacy inspires you?

entries.passageText: O ye who believe! Come, all of you, into submission (unto Him); and follow not the footsteps of the devil. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
entries.reflection: Enter into submission completely, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Faith asks for the whole person.
studyPrompts: What part of you holds back?
What would wholehearted faith look like?
What footsteps tempt you?

entries.passageText: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.
entries.reflection: Bear with what they say, and glorify your Lord before sunrise and sunset, and in the night, that you may be content. Praise can settle a restless heart.
studyPrompts: What makes you restless?
How could praise help?
When could you pause to glorify Allah?

entries.passageText: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.
entries.reflection: Allah asks of no soul more than He has given it, and after hardship He will grant ease. When you are overwhelmed, remember the load is measured, and ask for help.
studyPrompts: What is overwhelming you?
What is beyond what you have been given?
Who could help you carry it?

entries.passageText: O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and obey the messenger and those of you who are in authority; and if ye have a dispute concerning any matter, refer it to Allah and the messenger if ye are (in truth) believers in Allah and the Last Day. That is better and more seemly in the end.
entries.reflection: Obey Allah, obey the Messenger and those in authority among you, and refer disputes to Allah and the Messenger. Authority has its place within a higher accountability.
studyPrompts: Who is in authority over you?
How do you relate to them?
What higher accountability guides you?

entries.passageText: Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.
entries.reflection: Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah and the good things He provides? Enjoying good things is permitted and good.
studyPrompts: What good things do you enjoy?
When did you last rest?
How could you enjoy Allah's provision with gratitude?

entries.passageText: Their flesh and their food reach not Allah, but the devotion from you reacheth Him. Thus have We made them subject unto you that ye may magnify Allah that He hath guided you. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the good.
entries.reflection: Their flesh and blood do not reach Allah, but your devotion reaches Him. The heart behind the sacrifice is what matters.
studyPrompts: What sacrifice are you making?
What devotion is behind it?
How could your intention be purer?

entries.passageText: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
entries.reflection: This is a reminder for anyone who has a heart or lends an ear with full attention. Attention opens the way to understanding.
studyPrompts: What deserves your full attention?
What distracts you?
How could you listen with your heart?

entries.passageText: But seek the abode of the Hereafter in that which Allah hath given thee and neglect not thy portion of the world, and be thou kind even as Allah hath been kind to thee, and seek not corruption in the earth; lo! Allah loveth not corrupters,
entries.reflection: Seek the home of the Hereafter with what Allah has given you, but do not forget your share of this world. Faith calls for balance.
studyPrompts: Is your life balanced?
Are you neglecting your share of this world, or the next?
What would balance look like?

entries.passageText: And of them (also) is he who saith: "Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire."
entries.reflection: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter. Ambition can include both, rightly ordered.
studyPrompts: What good do you seek in this world?
What good do you seek in the next?
How do you keep them in order?

entries.passageText: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak From the evil of that which He created; From the evil of the darkness when it is intense, And from the evil of malignant witchcraft, And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
entries.reflection: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak from the evil of what He created and the darkness when it is intense. Muslims recite Al-Falaq for protection.
studyPrompts: What do you seek refuge from?
When do you recite prayers for protection?
Whom could you pray protection over?

entries.passageText: Their prayer therein will be: Glory be to Thee, O Allah! and their greeting therein will be: Peace. And the conclusion of their prayer will be: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
entries.reflection: The greeting of the people of Paradise is: Peace. The greeting of peace, as-salamu alaykum, carries goodwill into every meeting.
studyPrompts: How do you greet others?
Whom could you wish peace?
What would goodwill look like today?

entries.passageText: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
entries.reflection: Let them forgive and overlook; would you not love for Allah to forgive you? Letting go of grievances mirrors the forgiveness we hope for.
studyPrompts: What grievance are you holding?
What would overlooking it look like?
How does hope for forgiveness change you?

entries.passageText: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered? Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing. Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
entries.reflection: There was a time when man was nothing to be remembered; then Allah created him, gave him hearing and sight, and showed him the way. Life is a gift with purpose. If you are struggling, reach out today.
studyPrompts: What makes you feel alive?
What purpose do you see in your life?
Who reminds you that your life matters?

entries.passageText: Lo! We have given thee Abundance; So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
entries.reflection: We have given you abundance, so pray to your Lord and sacrifice. Many commentators connect this surah with the prayer and sacrifice of Eid al-Adha. Eid can be honored wherever you are.
studyPrompts: How will you mark the holidays where you are?
Whom could you celebrate with?
What abundance are you thankful for?

entries.passageText: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
entries.reflection: You will surely pass from stage to stage. Life moves through transitions by design.
studyPrompts: What stage are you passing through?
What helps you through transitions?
What do you hope for in the next stage?

entries.passageText: O mankind! Be careful of your duty to your Lord Who created you from a single soul and from it created its mate and from them twain hath spread abroad a multitude of men and women. Be careful of your duty toward Allah in Whom ye claim (your rights) of one another, and toward the wombs (that bare you). Lo! Allah hath been a watcher over you.
entries.reflection: O mankind, be mindful of your Lord who created you from a single soul and spread from it many men and women. We belong to one human family.
studyPrompts: Who is part of your human family?
How could you honor that bond?
What brings people together where you serve?
